title: How a Gas Boiler Works in 60 Seconds 🔥💧 #shorts
description:
A modern condensing gas boiler burns gas to heat water in a heat exchanger, then pumps it to your radiators and taps. The clever part: it cools its own exhaust until the water vapour condenses, grabbing heat that older boilers threw away. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#boiler #centralheating #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A modern gas boiler squeezes extra heat out of its own *exhaust* by turning it back into water.
steps.statsub: OF GAS ENERGY HIDES IN THE STEAM

steps.label: Burner
steps.text: Gas mixes with air and burns in the *burner*, making a hot blue flame.

steps.label: Heat exchanger
steps.text: The flame heats a *heat exchanger*, a metal coil filled with water.

steps.label: Pump
steps.text: A *pump* sends that hot water to your radiators and taps.

steps.label: Condensing
steps.text: The exhaust is cooled until its water vapour *condenses*, releasing hidden heat.

steps.label: Flue
steps.text: A fan pushes the cooled exhaust out the *flue*, and the water drains away.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Burn, heat, *condense*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
